data.assessment: In this quiet period service is close to its ceiling under v2 (block_k 2, hold_limit 60s): 85.4 of 87.4 orders are on time, late deliveries are 2.0, unfinished is 0.0 and p95_wait_s is 99.6, so at most about 2 more on-time deliveries can be gained. Road violations are 28.2 (release overstays 21.0, blocking_guard 7.2), about the 28.0 accepted in D2 and below the 34.8 trigger. The cost falls unevenly: C's sanctions reach 20.1, leaving C a utility of 10.5 against 26.8 for A and B (utility_gap 16.3), even though C's on-time rate (0.99) is the highest.

proposals.title: Lower sanction_lambda 0.5 -> 0.0 to relieve C's disproportionate road penalties
proposals.rationale: C carries 20.1 of the 21.3 sanction points (utility 10.5 vs 26.8 for A and B), mainly from hold-time and blocking violations, while its customer service is the best in town (on-time rate 0.99). D5 judged C not to be in distress at that time; the new fact is this period's utility gap of 16.3. Setting lambda to 0 should not change routing or customer measures, so on_time_deliveries, p95_wait_s, late_deliveries and unfinished should stay unchanged, while C's utility rises by about 20 and B's by about 1. A should vote yes (unchanged), and B and C yes, but the change will almost certainly fail the +1.0 on-time improvement gate.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.0                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 60s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
proposals.why_human: This change gives no customer gain and will most likely fail the on-time improvement gate. Its purpose is fairness between companies, not the KPI. Removing the sanction also removes the only deterrent against road violations, whose safety meaning is unknown and which the human has said should be monitored (D2-D5). Whether to trade some deterrence for relief of C's disproportionate penalty burden is a value judgment for the human.
assumptions: Robot routing and parking behaviour does not respond to lambda, so customer measures and road violations stay roughly unchanged.
C's 20.1 sanction points come mainly from road violations (release overstays and blocking_guard evictions), not from late deliveries.
Company utility is on-time deliveries minus sanction points, as stated in the constitution.
unknowns: Whether any company's parking strategy adapts to the sanction weight; if it does, road violations and blocked_s could rise.
Whether the human can or would adopt a change that fails the min_improvement gate.
Whether C's low utility persists in busier periods or is specific to quiet demand.

predictions.subject: metric:on_time_deliveries
predictions.note: Lambda only scales penalty points; expected change is below the 1.0 gate.

predictions.subject: metric:p95_wait_s
predictions.note: No change to routing or hold rules.

predictions.subject: metric:late_deliveries
predictions.note: Contract and road rules otherwise unchanged.

predictions.subject: metric:road_violations
predictions.note: Unchanged if behaviour does not depend on lambda; could rise if it does.

predictions.subject: metric:sanction_total
predictions.note: Sanction total falls from 21.3 to about 0.

predictions.subject: metric:utility_gap
predictions.note: C gains about 20 utility, closing most of the 16.3 gap.

predictions.subject: vote:A
predictions.note: A has 0 sanctions, so its utility is unchanged.

predictions.subject: vote:C
predictions.note: C's utility rises from 10.5 to about 30.
